_comment: Exact model revisions this deployment is known to work with.
Without these, a re-download silently pulls whatever upstream is current,
so a rebuilt machine can get different weights than the one that was tested.
Bump deliberately via ./update.sh, never by hand-editing during a fix.

ACE-Step/acestep-5Hz-lm-0.6B.note: The planning LM this hardware tier actually uses; the bundled 1.7B is never loaded here

dhairyashil/FLUX.1-schnell-mflux-4bit.note: Image. Ungated pre-quantized mirror — black-forest-labs' own repo is gated

mlx-community/gemma-4-e4b-it-4bit.note: Text/code generation, served by mlx_lm.server. Reasoning model — send chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false for direct answers.
